value.rationale: The result gives a natural complete classification for the generalized forcing rule on the two canonical graph-power families singled out by the initiating paper. It shows a general lower bound is sharp throughout an infinite two-family, three-parameter regime and identifies the exact threshold transition to one initial vertex. The result is structural rather than a finite census.
